description: Route a voice command to one of 7 skills. The model sees the transcribed utterance and picks which skill should handle it. Merged from 10 original skills based on confusion matrix analysis.

skill.instructions: Which skill should handle this request?

criteria.handle_bills: paying bills, checking account balances, reading bills from email, utility payments, insurance payments
criteria.check_schedule: calendar, appointments, medication reminders, daily schedule, what to do today
criteria.contact_family: calling family, reading emails from family, checking messages from relatives
criteria.get_groceries: ordering groceries, shopping lists, food delivery, picking up items
criteria.check_safety: scam detection, fraud checks, weather safety, verifying suspicious messages
criteria.general_help: questions, calculations, information lookup, how-to help, general assistance
criteria.emergency: urgent help, medical emergency, safety threat, immediate danger

usage.handle_bills: launch bill-pay flow or read bill-related emails
usage.check_schedule: read calendar or set/read medication reminders
usage.contact_family: initiate call or read family emails
usage.check_safety: run scam screen or check weather
usage.general_help: pass to System 2 for open-ended response
usage.emergency: immediate escalation — bypass all other checks

confidence_bands.medium: 0.50–0.79 — ask user to confirm ('Did you want to pay a bill?')
confidence_bands.low: < 0.50 — fall back to general_help or ask for clarification
